d.x: Another important meta-ethical theory is known as emotivism or non-cognitivism. Emotivists ... claim that all ethical statements are literally meaningless.

Empusa.e: From Ancient Greek Ἔμπουσα (Émpousa, “species of monster of Greek mythology”).

d.g: In Ancient Greek mythology, a kind of spectre sent by Hecate to guard roads and devour travellers.
